prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

report.answer: I added POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, the episodes from there on move down one, and non-members get the same 404 as for a missing episode. On the Episodes page, the message after a delete now has an Undo button that restores the episode in the list without a reload, in English and Korean. All 17 backend tests pass (4 of them new for restore), type-checking is clean, and I added no new lint problems. Notes: (1) "The place it had" is the number the episode had when it was deleted. If enough episodes were deleted since then that this place is past the end, it comes back last. (2) Restoring an episode that isn't deleted returns it unchanged with a 200 instead of an error, so a double-clicked Undo is harmless. (3) To add the Undo button I gave the shared toast an optional action button. Undo can only be clicked while the message is showing, about 5 seconds. (4) The delete confirmation on this page used to say the delete "cannot be undone"; it now has its own text in both languages, and the delete success and error messages, which were in English only, are now translated.

+"""Keeps a project's episodes numbered 1, 2, 3... with no gaps or repeats.
+
+Only episodes that are not deleted take part in the numbering.
+"""
+from typing import List, Optional
+from uuid import UUID
+
+from sqlmodel import Session, select
+
+from app.models import Episode
+
+
+def _ordered_episodes(session: Session, project_id: UUID, exclude: Optional[UUID] = None) -> List[Episode]:
+    statement = (
+        select(Episode)
+        .where(Episode.project_id == project_id)
+        .where(Episode.deleted_at == None)  # noqa: E711
+        .order_by(Episode.episode_order, Episode.created_at)
+    )
+    return [ep for ep in session.exec(statement).all() if ep.id != exclude]
+
+
+def _assign(session: Session, episodes: List[Episode]) -> bool:
+    changed = False
+    for number, ep in enumerate(episodes, start=1):
+        if ep.episode_order != number:
+            ep.episode_order = number
+            session.add(ep)
+            changed = True
+    return changed
+
+
+def place_episode(session: Session, episode: Episode, position: Optional[int] = None) -> None:
+    """Puts `episode` at `position` (1-based; None or past the end = last)
+    among its project's episodes and renumbers them all. Does not commit."""
+    session.flush()
+    others = _ordered_episodes(session, episode.project_id, exclude=episode.id)
+    if position is None or position > len(others) + 1:
+        index = len(others)
+    else:
+        index = max(position, 1) - 1
+    others.insert(index, episode)
+    episode.episode_order = 0  # forces the assignment below
+    _assign(session, others)
+
+
+def renumber_episodes(session: Session, project_id: UUID) -> bool:
+    """Closes gaps and repeats in the project's numbering. Does not commit.
+    Returns whether anything changed."""
+    session.flush()
+    return _assign(session, _ordered_episodes(session, project_id))

+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+
+def _project_with(client, h, titles):
+    pid = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "P", "genres": []}).json()["id"]
+    ids = {}
+    for i, title in enumerate(titles, start=1):
+        r = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": title, "project_id": pid, "episode_order": i})
+        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+        ids[title] = r.json()["id"]
+    return pid, ids
+
+
+def _orders(client, h, pid):
+    return [(e["title"], e["episode_order"]) for e in client.get("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, params={"project_id": pid}).json()]
+
+
+def _cuts(client, h, episode_id):
+    return client.get("/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, params={"episode_id": episode_id}).json()
+
+
+def test_restore_brings_episode_back_with_its_cuts_at_its_place(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, ids = _project_with(client, h, ["A", "B", "C", "D"])
+    for i, script in enumerate(["one", "two"], start=1):
+        client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, json={
+            "episode_id": ids["B"], "cut_order": i, "script": script, "image_path": f"cuts/b/{i}.png",
+        })
+    cuts_before = _cuts(client, h, ids["B"])
+
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ids['B']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [("A", 1), ("C", 2), ("D", 3)]
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ids['B']}", headers=h).status_code == 404
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ids['B']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.json()["id"] == ids["B"]
+    assert r.json()["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert r.json()["first_cut_image"].endswith("cuts/b/1.png")
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [("A", 1), ("B", 2), ("C", 3), ("D", 4)]
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ids['B']}", headers=h).status_code == 200
+    assert _cuts(client, h, ids["B"]) == cuts_before
+
+
+def test_restore_first_and_last(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, ids = _project_with(client, h, ["A", "B", "C"])
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ids['A']}", headers=h)
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ids['C']}", headers=h)
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [("B", 1)]
+
+    client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ids['C']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [("B", 1), ("C", 2)]
+    client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ids['A']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [("A", 1), ("B", 2), ("C", 3)]
+
+
+def test_restore_after_others_changed_keeps_numbering_without_gaps(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, ids = _project_with(client, h, ["A", "B", "C"])
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ids['C']}", headers=h)
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ids['A']}", headers=h)
+    # Only B is left; C's old place (3) is past the end now.
+    client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ids['C']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [("B", 1), ("C", 2)]
+
+    # Restoring the same episode twice changes nothing.
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ids['C']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [("B", 1), ("C", 2)]
+
+
+def test_non_members_cannot_restore(client):
+    owner = signup(client)
+    pid, ids = _project_with(client, owner, ["A", "B"])
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ids['A']}", headers=owner)
+    stranger = signup(client, email="stranger@example.com")
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ids['A']}/restore", headers=stranger)
+    assert r.status_code == 404
+    assert r.json().get("code") == "NOT_FOUND_EPISODE"
+    # A non-member can't tell a live episode from a missing one either.
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ids['B']}/restore", headers=stranger).json() == r.json()
+    missing = client.post("/api/v1/episodes/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/restore", headers=owner)
+    assert missing.status_code == 404 and missing.json() == r.json()
+
+    assert _orders(client, owner, pid) == [("B", 1)]
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ids['A']}/restore").status_code == 401
